match: Trimmed, case-insensitive identity substring. No geocoding or free-text metadata search.
filter: Optional exact network technology match after resolving the Cell profile against current settings and policy defaults.
emptyCriteria: Return zero rows and show Search the inventory. Do not render the entire loaded inventory.
tieBreak: Locale-independent intent via English numeric, case-insensitive identity comparison, then case-sensitive identity comparison.

resultBound.behavior: Explicitly increases the rendered page limit by 50; query/filter change resets it.

loadedInventorySearch: Client-side across all currently loaded tower records; the result count is exact for that loaded array.
